notes: Summary: Edge telemetry vendor building low-latency anomaly detection + similarity search for time-series signals. Primary ask: dedicated capacity with throughput guarantees (200–400 embeddings/sec), 99th pctl latency <200ms for chat-style alerting, bulk rerank jobs overnight. POC findings: 8k context needed for some long-series aggregation prompts; KV cache cut cold-start latency by ~40ms in hosted trial. Quantization: 8-bit + mixed-4bit gave 1.9–2.4x throughput but small accuracy delta on rare classes — team worried about false positives. Preferred models: Llama-2-70B variants and a trimmed 30B for cost tiers; want ability to fall back to cheaper variant when capacity constrained. Reserved GPU ask: started with planning for 8x A100-80GB or 12x H100 depending on kernel availability. Autoscaling policy: prefer predictable reserved baseline + burst to shared pools. SLA asks: 99.9% uptime, token-level incident diagnostics, support SLO for throughput variance. Security: VPC with customer-managed KMS, audit logs, 7-year retention for event traces (compliance). Legal: need PCI-like appendix (in progress). Quotes: "We can't accept more than 15% regression in detection accuracy for quantized models". Next actions: run dedicated perf matrix (context x batch x quant) and deliver cost/latency tradeoff doc; draft SLA template; finance to sign capex 3/2026. Linked artefacts below.
